posts.html:
Locating Target..........


Target Found: The C Man117
Age: 27 (not real age)
Crime:Possession of illegal products
Location Adress: Unknown

This is my story. I am The C Man. I was tight on money so i got a printer and a druglab. I did hav a secret location but somehow law enforcement found me. He tried to cuff me but i got away. Soon i was wanted by the law. The city was coverd by cops, patroling and asking questions. So i desided to move out of the city. sold my home, got rid of my stuff. and ran and ran and ran. I knew someone who lived out in the country so i thought he could help me. SHIT A COP, i ran behind a tree. Thank god he didnt see me.
Finally i thought as i got closer so i could see the house. FUUUUUUUUUCK. THERS A COP THER. he was talking to the owner. i paniked and hid behind trees, getting closer and closer. he was gone. DAMNIT.
2 Days (hours) later. i desided i could hide IN the city now. i changed my look and started walking down the streets. my fried was in the pd with a couple of cops. THIS was my chance to try my disguise. I came in and WHAM!, I stumple to the ground. The only thing on my eyes was the police man looking down at me. then i heard him say "We got him."
WTF IS UP WITH CELL i yelled in my mind. first of all thers no light in here. thers no bed, no sink, no cup i could swing around, ANd. And ther was a freak crying and saying that he was "innocent." FUCK. This is gonna be a long 30 hours (minutes).


pics of the places will be sumitted soon.[/FONT]
